question: Which is the oldest and most widespread industry in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Textile**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Textile industry** is the **oldest **and most widespread **industry **in India.
 
• It plays a significant role in the Indian economy by providing employment to millions and contributing substantially to the country's export earnings.
 
• The industry covers a wide range of activities from the production of raw materials like cotton, jute, silk, and wool, to the manufacturing of finished products like garments and apparels.
 
• India has a rich heritage of textiles, with a history that dates back to ancient times, when Indian textiles were highly sought after in international markets.
 
• The industry is known for its diverse range of products, including traditional handloom and handicraft items, as well as modern, machine-made fabrics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indian textile industry** is one of the largest in the world, with a vast raw material base and manufacturing strength across the value chain.
 
• The industry contributes around **7% to India's industrial output** in value terms, **2% to the GDP, and 15% to the country's export earnings**.
 
• It is the second largest employer in the country after agriculture, employing over 45 million people directly and 60 million people indirectly.
 
• Government initiatives like the **Textile Upgradation Fund Scheme (TUFS)** and **Make in India** campaign have provided a significant boost to the sector.
 
• The sector is expected to reach **USD 300 billion by 2025** with a CAGR of 10%.
